finding.headline: "The Husband Who Doesn't See the Mental Load"
finding.problem: "He pays school fees and thinks that's enough. He doesn't know the pediatrician's name. I'm keeping this house alive alone and I resent him."
finding.person: Nigerian wife whose husband 'provides' but doesn't 'nurture'; she carries invisible load of 3 kids + newborn; resentment building (Dipesh Patel; Phoenix, 2026).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (Fair-Play division-of-labor plan for African couples)". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
